_warning: VALEURS INDICATIVES tirées de la littérature (voir 'source'). A valider par ton agronome avant tout usage réel. Les valeurs 'estimate' et 'example' ne sont PAS des données publiées.

wheat.source: FAO Land & Water, crop information: wheat. Water requirement for high yields about 450-650 mm depending on climate and growing period. Central = midpoint.

fava.source: FAO AGRIS record on faba bean water relations (Egypt, 1979-81): total consumptive use 31.85, 39.03 and 41.73 cm in the Delta, Middle and Upper Egypt. Egyptian conditions, NOT Tunisia. Central = mean.

n_credit_next_cereal_kg_ha.source: Central: residual N benefit of faba bean = about 30 kg N/ha fertiliser saving for the following winter wheat (value cited in Tedone et al. 2022, Agronomy 13(1):105). High: mean faba N balance 40-46 kg N/ha in the same study. Low = 0 because the net N balance ranged from -21 to +41 kg N/ha in rainfed NE Spain (Reckling et al. 2024).

reference_cereal_n_rate_kg_ha.source: EXAMPLE VALUE, not a recommendation. Replace by the farmer's real dose or by the agronomist's figure.

legume_own_n_rate_kg_ha.source: Assumption: no mineral N on faba bean (a small starter dose is sometimes used; ignored here).

n2o_ef1_direct.source: IPCC 2006 Tier 1 default: 1% of applied N is emitted as N2O-N. Tier 1 uncertainty about +/-70% (low/high).

n2o_gwp100.source: IPCC AR6 100-year GWP of N2O (AR5 uses 265).

production_transport_kgco2e_per_kg_n.source: ESTIMATE, not a published factor: 5.765 kg CO2e/kg N (DEFRA combined field factor) x 38.8/58.6 (production share vs field share of fertiliser-supply-chain emissions, Menegat et al. 2022). Range = +/-50% (our assumption). Replace by a published production factor when available.
